objective: Finish the user-facing compute connection onboarding experience so normal users use Connect -> authorize/setup -> verify -> Ready without managing internal provider plumbing.

rulesConsidered: Provider authentication is separate from provider execution authority.
Raw provider secrets remain server-side and never enter journals, telemetry, MCP payloads, or F06 worker authority.
OAuth is used only where the provider exposes a real delegated authorization flow.
Provider completion is not physical artifact truth; F07 remains the independent artifact truth boundary.
No self-hosted PandaStack connection is introduced.

notes: PR #153 does not change secret storage or authentication primitives; it only changes provider onboarding presentation.
Kaggle OAuth permission identifiers are translated into human-readable UI copy without exposing token values.
Lightning remains guided-manual and does not claim unsupported delegated OAuth.
